data.promptProse: Trapped in a narrow fitting room with the back zipper of her date-night dress jammed halfway, Shokuhou Misaki twists her hands behind her back trying to reach it, the tight fabric squeezing her large breasts into a breathtaking spill of black lace against the lining. Her star-shaped pupils swim with flustered panic as she orders you to stop staring and help with your hands, gasping as the fabric strains. Warm overhead fitting-room light over squeezed flesh in a sensual solo composition, cinematic lighting.
